blocks.head: alt The user is not near any device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near deviceB, the only device
alt The user has key and is near a device
alt The user has key and the device exists
alt UserY has a key and the device exists

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : OldKey , ...) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : randomStr('Key', N) , ...) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > < deviceB | ('locked' : false , 'key' : Key , ...) > $ UserX 'retrieveKey' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | ('locked' : false , 'key' : Key , ...) > .

eq < deviceB | ('locked' : false , 'key' : Key , ..) > $ UserX 'lock' deviceB | (Key) 
= < deviceB | ('locked' : true , 'key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : Owners , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key) 
= < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ...) , ....) > .

eq < cloudA | (userC : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : Members , ..) , ...) > $ userC 'invite' cloudA | (userA) 
= < cloudA | (userC : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : (userA , Members) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (userC : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : (userA , Members) , ..) , ...) > $ userC 'remove' cloudA | (userA) 
= < cloudA | (userC : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : Members , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (..) > $ UserY 'retrieveCloudKey' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key) 
= < cloudA | (..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
